knowledge_card_pair.topic_type: post-cutoff civil-disobedience movement vs interim government

card.fact_statement: Nahid Islam addressed the assembled crowd at Shaheed Minar to announce the movement's exclusive demand.
card.source_span: At around 5:30 p.m., Nahid Islam, one of the coordinators, addressed the assembled crowd at Shaheed Minar and announced that the movement's exclusive demand was the resignation of Hasina and her cabinet.

card.fact_statement: General Waker-uz-Zaman handed the resignation of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to the President.
card.source_span: On 5 August 2024, General Waker-uz-Zaman, the Chief of the Army Staff, handed the resignation of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to President Mohammed Shahabuddin
